- **Changeset sentences read in person** against the head: the title row (icon, name, "New X", help), the one toolbar row (source dropdown with counts, search), the removed breadcrumb / tiles / refresh / sort dropdown / "only customizations", header sort with Name by API name; full-bleed table, icon tile, label over mono API name, right-aligned numbers, no plural label on objects, Modified-at and Source hidden when uniform; the three source words and their rule (mark first, then provenance, `studioListSource.ts`); ‹ › order reading the same function (`useListOrderedNames.ts`); the tooltip on a paired read-only base with the new key; Setup and the no-host list unchanged. All true.
- **The four re-pointed tests are not weakened.** `pairCreate-36897` and `allTypes-37360` find New by test id / "New X" prefix and keep every assertion. `customizations-28568` swaps the mark reads for the Source badge (kind, words and the mark's title), keeps the system-shipped control, and replaces the toggle clicks with the `?source=runtime` address plus the dropdown count, still asserting the unmarked row leaves. `objectExtensionName-29569` keeps modified vs new with a control; the one case whose two rows are both new now asserts the column is hidden, which is decision 7's rule, and the new-vs-modified distinction stays pinned in the next case. The label-leads case gains a no-label control.
- **Source classification (mark first):** right for the reason the body measures — a served override is served under the base's id, so provenance alone would file it under system-shipped. The list's filter and ‹ › read one function.
- **Decision 8 path:** New stays enabled on a paired read-only base (ADR-0146 D3), gets the tooltip plus `aria-describedby`, no banner; the writable control is unchanged. The tooltip case has an ablation red/green in the body, as do the title-icon and description fixes.

- Both cards ask for light and dark screenshots **on the PR**; the relay cannot attach images, so they are kept with the project thread (`objectstack-seat3/shots-37918/`) and the body describes each. Accepted.
- An old `?customized=1` address no longer narrows the Studio list (folded into "modified and new"); `?sort=label` still sorts with no header arrow. Accepted, both stated in the body.
- Body prose: the two-minute check still says "16 passed"; the new file holds 18 cases. The zone may patch the body; it does not move the head.
